verdict.rationale: GitLab merge requests are a core known feature enabling online code review with inline comments, and evidence confirms MR-based workflows (security findings appear in merge requests) and Git/CI documentation, but the evidence pack lacks direct documentation of the inline discussion/reply-to-comment feature itself. missing for 10: explicit docs on inline diff comments/threaded discussions, resolving/replying to review comments, independent hands-on confirmation of this specific workflow.
